title: Custom Health Checks with Spring Boot Actuator
title_es: Health Checks Personalizados con Spring Boot Actuator
description: Custom Spring Boot Actuator HealthIndicator implementations: payment gateway, PostgreSQL, Redis, external API with timeouts, queue depth with degraded status, reactive variant, ApplicationAvailability listeners, plus application.yml groups and Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes.
description_es: Implementaciones personalizadas de HealthIndicator para Spring Boot Actuator: pasarela de pago, PostgreSQL, Redis, API externa con timeouts, profundidad de cola con estado degradado, variante reactiva, listeners de ApplicationAvailability, más grupos en application.yml y probes de liveness/readiness en Kubernetes.
